articles.title: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is buying its CEO’s venture capital business, Tribe
articles.snippet: Sethi, who was appointed co-CEO of Kraken in October 2024, is also the chairman of Tribe Capital.

articles.title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

articles.title: Polymarket US takes rapid-fire crypto trading format to oil, natural gas
articles.snippet: Polymarket US said it attracted more than 300,000 traders to its short-duration crypto markets in six weeks and is now expanding the format to energy commodities.

articles.title: Tokenized Nvidia market cap surges 159% amid Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.snippet: Nvidia stock tokens reached $401.9 million in combined value as Jensen Huang stepped down and the chipmaker posted record quarterly revenue.

articles.title: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko
articles.snippet: Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, its product chief said, as the crypto data platform explores trading features.
